articles.title: UK Issues Sanctions Against Justin Sun's HTX, Other Crypto Firms Over Alleged Russia Ties
articles.snippet: British financial institutions are now barred from doing business with the exchanges—and may face penalties for interacting with crypto transactions that pass through them.

articles.title: Tom Lee's BitMine Makes Biggest Ethereum Buy Yet in 2026
articles.snippet: BitMine Immersion Technologies made its largest Ethereum acquisition yet this year—just weeks after saying it might slow down its ETH buys.

articles.title: StepFun's Voice AI Topped Every Benchmark. It Also Hears Your Sighs
articles.snippet: The Shanghai lab that builds LLMs that punch above their weight just turned that same energy on voice—and the results are hard to ignore.

articles.title: Now You Can Buy Bitcoin, XRP and More in ChatGPT via MoonPay
articles.snippet: MoonPay's new app lets users buy cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and Solana, through ChatGPT just by speaking with the chatbot.

articles.title: Microsoft's Free AI Just Beat OpenAI and Google at Browsing the Web
articles.snippet: Fara1.5 is a family of open-weight browser agents from Microsoft Research that outperforms OpenAI's Operator and Google's Gemini 2.5 Computer Use on the industry's toughest live-web benchmark.
